privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption
title: Cross-repo pass: rules that differ without a project marker, one owner per topic
goal: Each topic stated in several places has one named owner and the others link to it
acceptance: rules that differ between repositories without a `<!-- project -->` marker or a recorded override are listed with both texts (a copied harness file that was edited here counts)

each topic stated in several places (audit cadence: harness F-104-T03 and F-105, coordinator cross-project audit check 5, per-project audit settings; landing queue; freeze and ask-first lists) gets one named owner and a link from the others; terms used two ways across repositories are listed with the term the owner should keep

effort.basis: one read over the nine T01 pages plus the harness template, about 20 topics. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed for coordinator-only work. Not a measurement.
